ruleDefinitions.name: AD Groups Or Users Enumeration Using PowerShell - PoshModule
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may attempt to find domain-level groups and permission settings.
The knowledge of domain-level permission groups can help adversaries determine which groups exist and which users belong to a particular group.
Adversaries may use this information to determine which users have elevated permissions, such as domain administrators.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Payload, ContextInfo

sequences.query: ((Payload = RGX(".*get\\-ADPrincipalGroupMembership.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*get\\-ADPrincipalGroupMembership.*")) OR ((Payload = RGX(".*get\\-aduser.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\-f\\ .*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\-pr\\ .*") AND Payload = RGX(".*DoesNotRequirePreAuth.*")) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*get\\-aduser.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-f\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-pr\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*DoesNotRequirePreAuth.*"))))
